behavior: Explicit durable Inbox mode with four public APIs. Writer consumes the exact recovered State and READY Journal.
Allocation-free Take copies the canonical wire to caller storage. Bounded FIFO of ready records, no additional queue allocation.
Nonwrapping per-incarnation lease identifiers fence stale or foreign copies. Return requeues at the ready tail.
Accepted application ACK consumes the claim. Physical COMMITTED removes delivery, including late cancellation/Close. Definite non-commit requeues with a new claim.
Raw Inbox ACK is refused before IO in lease mode. It remains available on the legacy writer.
Protocol QoS2 identity and application delivery retire independently, through the same exact writer queue.
new_fixture: 16 offline lease cases/program across MQTT 5.0 and 3.1.1, including four consumers and 32 native durable acknowledgements per protocol.
Two actual TCP scenarios/program queue PUBREL behind a held application ACK, one per protocol, plus existing 26 Client scenarios.
Definite timeout, quota/output refusal, actual one-byte allocation cap, uncertain sync, Close/cancel during flush and cancelled native pump.
Native temp-file example reopens the journal and checks no pending delivery. Same real application runs linked against static and shared packages.
WSL ASan/UBSan/leak detection on full new suite and Clang 21 TSan on the lease and actual TCP modular scenarios.
